notes:
State Cliopatria lacks: its Duchy of Łęczyca row covers 1138-1144 (duchy-of-eczyca, eu-15-d). Slug follows slug.py for 'Duchy of Łęczyca (1231-1352)'. The page is thin (lead and two map captions): no ruler list, no wars, no area; the 1352 incorporation conflicts with the Sieradz page's 1339 for the neighbour. The Łęczyca page says nothing on Bohemian rule (1299-1306), which the Sieradz page gives only for Sieradz; Łęczyca's own history in 1231-1352 needs another page (Władysław the Hunchback; Kuyavian dukes). Counterpart 'nobody' for 1231 stands for the Seniorate province, which no state held after 1138.

Not settled: (1) Łęczyca's rulers and the Kuyavian and Bohemian overlordship. (2) The 70/60 km radii are stand-ins. (3) The 1231 'around' date.
